title: A lead texts after closing time

beats.say: A new patient texts at 21:14. The practice closed at six.

do.text: Hi, I chipped a tooth. Can I come in this week?

beats.say: They get an answer in seconds, not the next morning.

do.text: Sorry to hear that! We can see you Thursday at 10:00 or Friday at 14:30. Which works?

beats.say: The owner hears about it once it is booked.
